name: Potion to Alcohol
body:
School transmutation; Level alchemist/investigator 2, bard/skald 2, bloodrager 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a grape)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target 1 touched dose of potion
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort negates (harmless, object); Spell Resistance yes (harmless, object)

DESCRIPTION

This spell converts a touched dose of potion, elixir, or other magical liquid into alcohol. The alcohol is of good quality and has the effects of a strong drink. The spell doesn’t work on holy/unholy water or on an alchemist’s extracts.
